name: Forno Acqua Standard White Luxurious Smart Toilet
shortDescription: FORNO ACQUA Smart Toilet – Smart Performance, Streamlined Design. Discover the perfect balance of innovation and simplicity with the FORNO ACQUA Smart Toilet, a sleek tankless skirted toilet designed for budget-conscious homeowners who still want smart functionality. Ideal for powder rooms, guest bathrooms, and minimalist spaces. Certified to MaP’s highest performance standards, the Auto Dual Flush system delivers powerful, clog-free performance. Walk away sensors and Foot sensor enables total touchless flushing. Soft-close seat for quiet, gentle operation. Built-in night light for safe, convenient nighttime use. Sleek tankless, skirted design for easy cleaning and a modern look. Enjoy smart performance without the extras. The FORNO ACQUA Smart Toilet delivers a cleaner, more comfortable bathroom experience—without a bidet, heated seat, or auto-lid. Essential features. Elegant design. FORNO ACQUA simplicity.

features.text: Smart Toilet Auto Flush, Foot Sensor
Built-In Bidet – Adjustable spray strength, water temperature, nozzle position and massage functions (pulsate & oscillate) for personalized hygiene & comfort
High-Performance Flush – AcquaPOWER technology delivers best-in-class 1000g MaP performance for a quiet, powerful, clog-free waste removal
Heated Seat – Enjoy soothing warmth with 4 adjustable temperature settings for personalized comfort year-round
Touchless Walk-Away Flush – AcquaSMART triggers a smart dual flush when you step away or tap the foot sensor. Hands-free, hygienic, and effortless
AcquaSMART Advanced Technology - automatic lid open & close, foot sensor seat open & close and lid close for seamless, hands-free convenience
Smart Dual Flush – Automatically adjusts flush volume based on usage to maximize water efficiency
